original.statement: The Cilium Operator's six CiliumEndpointSlice rate limit flags (ces-write-qps-limit, ces-write-qps-burst, ces-enable-dynamic-rate-limit, ces-dynamic-rate-limit-nodes, ces-dynamic-rate-limit-qps-limit, ces-dynamic-rate-limit-qps-burst) are deprecated and their usage is now ignored; the ces-rate-limits flag or ciliumEndpointSlice.rateLimits Helm value replaces them.

decision.reason: [ev-7994b2163342] lists `ces-write-qps-limit` among the deprecated operator flags whose "usage will be ignored". The fixed subject is that single cilium-operator flag, so only environments that set the flag are affected. The exposure cli-flag{--ces-write-qps-limit, component cilium-operator, set} covers exactly those environments. The other five flags are separate subjects and do not widen this condition.
